name: Community Expansion
description:
This mod introduces the following new elements:

Artifacts:
- Fang of the Last Scream
- Great Battle Bow
- Great Woe of the Crawlers
- Hollow Eye

Map Objects:
- Guard Tower
- Steel Golem Factory
- Lightning Generator
- Wind Turbine

Other Objects:
- Kangaroo
- Lightning Generator
- Wind Turbine

Note: This is unofficial content created by the community.
author: Ben YAN

1.2.0: Add new artifacts from HoMM2, which also be mentioned from HotA campaign All In
1.1.0: New appearance for artifact Hollow Eye, and new video for Factory Town
